scope: Offline source and isolated mocked behavior audit; no live database, messaging or publishing

scenarios.name: A01: addShipping reports success after database denial
A02: deleteShipping reports success after secureDelete denies deletion
A03: unknown action reports success
A04: deleteUser ignores username supplied by its caller
A05: simultaneous orders calculate identical order IDs
A06: settlement changes total without updating outstanding balance
A07: checkout overwrites an already closed attendance record
A08: cached session survives server response showing suspended user
A09: stale offer save upserts unrelated offers and old publication state
A10: failed cloud bouquet deletion still removes it locally
A11: successful cloud reload discards unsynchronized local bouquet
A12: backend publishes expired date-based offer
A13: backend publishes exhausted count-based recurring story
A14: one-platform failure still advances shared publication timestamp
A15: backend passes full Supabase URL as hostname without normalization
A16: Drive handler permits unauthenticated deletion of arbitrary accessible file
A17: failed replacement upload trashes original image first
A18: fractional product quantity is truncated when deducting offer stock
A19: history renderer inserts customer-provided HTML without escaping
A20: users with expiry-only or inventory-only permission cannot load their base data
A21: logout retains cleartext password in sessionStorage
A22: weekly reader treats HTTP 403 as an empty successful dataset
A23: sequential publication retries after database patch failure can duplicate an existing story
